name: filter_isi_650_1nm
label: ISI 1 nm filter, 650 nm (650 nm)
sources: P. Nugent, 2026-10-21: two 1 nm filters; 900 nm kept, the 1550 nm filter replaced by 650 nm when the silicon PDM replaced the InGaAs ID230
notes: Red continuum at the PDE's 0.37; in the TiO bands of the M supergiants, so the 650 vs 900 nm size difference measures the molecular layers.
Throughput 0.9 = FILTER_THROUGHPUT (filter + relay optics); the telescope file carries the rest.
Coherence time 1.4 ps, below the PDM's 50 ps jitter: the band width sets the count rate, not the g2 width.
